notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.2.5 Now Live!
notes.content:
[p][b]❄ Demo V0.2.5 Patch Notes ❄[/b][/p][p]This update revamps cooking, improves survival balance, adds clearer feedback (icons, flashes, SFX), and fixes several crashes and edge cases. Thanks for all the reports and playtime![/p][p][/p][p]Gameplay[/p][list][*][p]Cooking revamped: food is now cooked directly at the campfire instead of via crafting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Frozen Potable Water and Frozen Unsafe Water.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Day 1 midnight campfire auto-extinguish event (to avoid confusion).[/p][/*][*][p]Activities rebalanced: timings now feel more realistic
(e.g., drinking water now takes 3 minutes instead of 15 — no more leisurely sipping!).[/p][/*][*][p]Small carcasses (rat, squirrel, fox) are now movable.[/p][/*][*][p]Partial harvests enabled for fallen/dead trees and large carcasses (bear, wolf, fox) instead of one massive 4h+ action.[/p][/*][*][p]Campfire warmth increased by 5°C to avoid freezing near fire.[/p][/*][*][p]Bedroll warmth buffed to prevent freezing while sleeping.[/p][/*][*][p]Crash Site exploration cap removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Woods: guaranteed minimum of 2 item types per explore, improved wood drop rates, and capped at 1 cigarette butt.[/p][/*][*][p]Torch objective renamed from “Equip” to “Light.”[/p][/*][*][p]Starter Campfire now defaults to Torch as the first item.[/p][/*][*][p]Tool order for opening cans updated.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]UI/UX[/p][list][*][p]Objectives system:[/p][/*][*][p]Completed objectives cannot be re-added as active.[/p][/*][*][p]Completed objectives now auto-collapse.[/p][/*][*][p]Objective text auto-scales to fit.[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltip system overhauled: tooltips auto-fit text length (afflictions, sleep, categories, wiki, etc).[/p][/*][*][p]Insufficient material/tool tooltip now links to Wiki on click.[/p][/*][*][p]Harvested items auto-scroll into view in loot containers.[/p][/*][*][p]Over-encumbrance icon added to top-right afflictions panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Needs/conditions indicators added:[/p][list][*][p]Up/down arrows show changes each turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Flashing warnings when needs/conditions <25%.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Flashing icon for over-encumbrance.[/p][/*][*][p]Sleep popup description updated; warmth bonus/punishment displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Card movement controls improved:[/p][list][*][p]Existing Shift + drag and Shift + right-click still work.[/p][/*][*][p]Added middle mouse click to move a whole stack.[/p][/*][*][p]Added right-click + drag to move a whole stack.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]BGM volume reduced across the board; Crash Site music made less piercing.[/p][/*][*][p]Added dusk and morning SFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX + notification when items break or rot.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed dragging cards left↔right multiple times sometimes freezing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed equipped items being incorrectly counted toward backpack carry weight.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crafting with multiple firewood types not auto-switching when one type is consumed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pluralization issue on hrs/mins labels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed completed objectives monologue missing punctuation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tooltip persistence after hovering buttons (location/crafting/affliction/equipment).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed food poisoning bug that incorrectly increased sanity drain rate when triggered multiple times.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated various event monologues; added new ones when needs are depleted.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, we’d love to hear what you think. Join our [url="https://discord.gg/dPT8d6KVSC"]Discord[/url] and tell us how your latest run went.[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Cooking revamped: food is now cooked directly at the campfire instead of via crafting.
Added Frozen Potable Water and Frozen Unsafe Water.

tags.balance_change:
Activities rebalanced: timings now feel more realistic
(e.g., drinking water now takes 3 minutes instead of 15 — no more leisurely sipping!).

tags.feature: Small carcasses (rat, squirrel, fox) are now movable.
Partial harvests enabled for fallen/dead trees and large carcasses (bear, wolf, fox) instead of one massive 4h+ action.

tags.balance_change: Campfire warmth increased by 5°C to avoid freezing near fire.
Bedroll warmth buffed to prevent freezing while sleeping.

tags.feature: Crash Site exploration cap removed.
Woods: guaranteed minimum of 2 item types per explore, improved wood drop rates, and capped at 1 cigarette butt.
Torch objective renamed from “Equip” to “Light.”
Starter Campfire now defaults to Torch as the first item.
Tool order for opening cans updated.
Completed objectives cannot be re-added as active.
Completed objectives now auto-collapse.
Objective text auto-scales to fit.
Tooltip system overhauled: tooltips auto-fit text length (afflictions, sleep, categories, wiki, etc).
Insufficient material/tool tooltip now links to Wiki on click.
Harvested items auto-scroll into view in loot containers.
Over-encumbrance icon added to top-right afflictions panel.
Needs/conditions indicators added:
Up/down arrows show changes each turn.
Flashing warnings when needs/conditions <25%.
Flashing icon for over-encumbrance.
Sleep popup description updated; warmth bonus/punishment displayed.
Card movement controls improved:
Existing Shift + drag and Shift + right-click still work.
Added middle mouse click to move a whole stack.
Added right-click + drag to move a whole stack.

tags.balance_change: BGM volume reduced across the board; Crash Site music made less piercing.

tags.feature: Added dusk and morning SFX.
Added SFX + notification when items break or rot.

tags.bug: Fixed dragging cards left↔right multiple times sometimes freezing the game.
Fixed equipped items being incorrectly counted toward backpack carry weight.
Fixed crafting with multiple firewood types not auto-switching when one type is consumed.
Fixed pluralization issue on hrs/mins labels.
Fixed completed objectives monologue missing punctuation.
Fixed tooltip persistence after hovering buttons (location/crafting/affliction/equipment).
Fixed food poisoning bug that incorrectly increased sanity drain rate when triggered multiple times.

tags.feature: Updated various event monologues; added new ones when needs are depleted.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.2.4 Now Live!
notes.content: [p][b]❄ Demo V0.2.4 Patch Notes ❄[/b][/p][p]This update adds quality-of-life improvements to sleeping, crafting, and clothing, plus some new player guidance, bug fixes, and a fresh item to help you stay warm.[/p][p][/p][p]Gameplay[/p][list][*][p]New item added: Hay (used in crafting, can be dried with grass).[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Bedroll recipe now includes Hay.[/p][/*][*][p]Starter Bedroll is now provided at the beginning of a new game (starts at 20% durability).[/p][/*][*][p]Bedroll durability now decreases based on how many hours you sleep.[/p][/*][*][p]Sleep popup now includes warmth bonuses or penalties based on how you sleep.[/p][/*][*][p]Added hypothermia warning for Sleeping on the Ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Chapter Title scenes and Game Over scenes are now skippable.[/p][/*][*][p]Bedroll, Improved Bedroll, and Bearskin Bedroll now require Cloth (not Scrap Cloth) for repair.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing warning popup when leaving the Crash Site after max exploration while items remain in the Loot Pile.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]UI/UX[/p][list][*][p]Card Details Page now allows equip/unequip of clothing and torches.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483580/cee7a58da61b313db83c3f657bfcb59b6df44000.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Equipped items now show durability on the Equipment Page.[/p][/*][*][p]“Harvest” button for canned food updated to say “Open” for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Sleep popup now shows warmth effects (bonus/punishment).[/p][/*][*][p]Objectives system updated with better guidance on moving cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Objective text now auto-scales height to prevent cutoff.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where tooltips remained visible after mouse was no longer hovering.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug report page now checks internet connection before submitting.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where sound settings were not saved between sessions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, we’d love to hear what you think. Join our [url="https://discord.gg/dPT8d6KVSC"]Discord[/url] and tell us how your latest run went.[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: New item added: Hay (used in crafting, can be dried with grass).
Improved Bedroll recipe now includes Hay.
Starter Bedroll is now provided at the beginning of a new game (starts at 20% durability).
Bedroll durability now decreases based on how many hours you sleep.
Sleep popup now includes warmth bonuses or penalties based on how you sleep.
Added hypothermia warning for Sleeping on the Ground.
Chapter Title scenes and Game Over scenes are now skippable.
Bedroll, Improved Bedroll, and Bearskin Bedroll now require Cloth (not Scrap Cloth) for repair.

tags.bug: Fixed missing warning popup when leaving the Crash Site after max exploration while items remain in the Loot Pile.

tags.feature: Card Details Page now allows equip/unequip of clothing and torches.
Equipped items now show durability on the Equipment Page.
“Harvest” button for canned food updated to say “Open” for clarity.
Sleep popup now shows warmth effects (bonus/punishment).
Objectives system updated with better guidance on moving cards.
Objective text now auto-scales height to prevent cutoff.

tags.bug: Fixed issue where tooltips remained visible after mouse was no longer hovering.
Bug report page now checks internet connection before submitting.
Fixed issue where sound settings were not saved between sessions.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.2.3 Now Live!
notes.content: [p][b]❄ Demo V0.2.3 Patch Notes ❄[/b][/p][p]This update fine-tunes survival balance, improves UI clarity, and fixes a few issues with location popups and affliction recovery. Canned food also gets a more realistic treatment.[/p][p][/p][p]Gameplay[/p][list][*][p]Canned food must now be opened (harvested) before eating.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483580/868324ade5a9e04c1c013e14394089874572305f.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Opened canned food can be heated to restore extra warmth and sanity. Eating it cold reduces both.[/p][/*][*][p]Harvesting time is now tool-dependent — using a simple shiv to open a can takes longer compared to a hunting knife or can opener.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483580/1f87fdfa4e843a54661b95137a904def29eaf046.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Balanced food and drink consumption time taken to be more realistic.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted food/drink effects: hot or cooked food restores warmth, while cold food reduces it.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced recovery and sleep time needed for afflictions.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased chances of finding seats at the Crash Site.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased chances of finding grass and wood in the Woods.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]UI/UX[/p][list][*][p]Updated affliction sleep time tooltips to be clearer and more informative.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed location card image blocking the bottom part of the popup when scrolled down.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated scrollbar colour in the location popup to match the correct theme.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed visual overlap in location popup that blocked content when scrolled to the bottom.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, we’d love to hear what you think. Join our [url="https://discord.gg/dPT8d6KVSC"]Discord[/url] and tell us how your latest run went.[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Canned food must now be opened (harvested) before eating.
Opened canned food can be heated to restore extra warmth and sanity. Eating it cold reduces both.
Harvesting time is now tool-dependent — using a simple shiv to open a can takes longer compared to a hunting knife or can opener.

tags.balance_change: Balanced food and drink consumption time taken to be more realistic.
Adjusted food/drink effects: hot or cooked food restores warmth, while cold food reduces it.
Reduced recovery and sleep time needed for afflictions.
Increased chances of finding seats at the Crash Site.
Increased chances of finding grass and wood in the Woods.

tags.feature: Updated affliction sleep time tooltips to be clearer and more informative.

tags.bug: Fixed location card image blocking the bottom part of the popup when scrolled down.
Updated scrollbar colour in the location popup to match the correct theme.
Fixed visual overlap in location popup that blocked content when scrolled to the bottom.

Cardboard Matches and Wood Matches can now be equipped like a torch, but only last for one turn.

tags.bug: Fixed fresh pelt from squirrel and rat not being able to dry on the Drying Rack.
Fixed crafting recipes that incorrectly used fresh hare/fox pelts instead of the cured versions.
Fixed Fresh Pelt and Gut items showing the wrong card detail popup (appearing as a large, empty space).

tags.feature: Updated Cooked Rat Meat to display the correct icon.

tags.balance_change: Reduced default sound effect volume from 60% to 40%.
Lowered volume on overly loud sound effects to be more comfortable.

tags.bug: Fixed sound effects not playing when starting a campfire or loading Chapter 2.
Fixed an issue where moving cards after applying filters could leave empty slots and sometimes block further progress.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.0.8 Now Live!
notes.content: [p][b]❄ Demo V0.0.8 Patch Notes ❄[/b][/p][p]We’ve just dropped a new patch for Don't Freeze! Thank you all for the incredible feedback, it’s been a huge help in shaping the game. Fixed an issue where the wishlist popup reappeared after saving/loading post–Day 6. It will now only trigger once when reaching Day 6 for the first time.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.0.6 Now Live!
notes.content: [p][b]❄ Demo V0.0.6 Patch Notes ❄[/b][/p][p]We’ve got some quality-of-life features, gameplay tweaks, and minor bug fixes in this update! Thanks again for all your feedback — it really helps us polish up the demo.[/p][p][/p][p]🕹 Gameplay[/p][p]• Torch can now be crafted in the dark (though it takes double the time)[/p][p]• Some food/drink can now be consumed in the dark (canned food still not allowed, and it also takes double the time)[/p][p]• Equipping torch now uses Light/Lighting, and unequipping uses Extinguish/Extinguishing[/p][p]• Equipping clothing now shows as Wear/Wearing, and unequipping as Take Off/Taking Off[/p][p][/p][p]🐞 Bugs[/p][p]• Fixed a bug where a notification appeared before the crafting animation finished in the crafting popup[/p][p]• Fixed an issue where the weight of a crafted item was added before the weight of spent items was subtracted, which could briefly push players into an over-encumbered state near the weight limit[/p][p][/p][p]⚙ Others[/p][p]• Added windowed/fullscreen support[/p][p]• Added resolution change support[/p][p]• Added Vsync support[/p][p]• Added support for ultra-wide screens (21:9)[/p][p][/p][p]Try out the new version and let us know what you think! You can chat with us and report bugs or feedback over on our [url="https://discord.gg/dPT8d6KVSC"]Discord[/url].[/p]

tags.feature: • Torch can now be crafted in the dark (though it takes double the time)
• Some food/drink can now be consumed in the dark (canned food still not allowed, and it also takes double the time)
• Equipping torch now uses Light/Lighting, and unequipping uses Extinguish/Extinguishing
• Equipping clothing now shows as Wear/Wearing, and unequipping as Take Off/Taking Off

tags.bug: • Fixed a bug where a notification appeared before the crafting animation finished in the crafting popup
• Fixed an issue where the weight of a crafted item was added before the weight of spent items was subtracted, which could briefly push players into an over-encumbered state near the weight limit

tags.feature: • Added windowed/fullscreen support
• Added resolution change support
• Added Vsync support
• Added support for ultra-wide screens (21:9)

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.0.5 Now Live!
notes.content: [p]🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.0.5 Now Live![/p][p]We’ve just released a new update with bug fixes, balance tweaks, and some UI improvements to make your winter death march just a little smoother. Read on:[/p][p][/p][p]🐞 Bug Fixes[/p][p]Fixed a bug where moving cards between left and right columns (or vice versa) would display incorrect badge numbers when filtered[/p][p]Fixed an issue with locale number formatting that caused players to die after the first turn (yes, that was real - thanks Unisus, and no, you did not miss anything, it was our bad)[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 Gameplay Updates[/p][p]Scrap metal can now be found in the Woods (low chance)[/p][p]Harvesting a seat now gives 3 scrap metal (up from 2) and 4 seat cushions (up from 2)[/p][p]Harvesting a seat cushion now gives 6 cloth (up from 4)[/p][p]Rebalanced weight and harvesting values for tinder-related items (sticks, newspapers, etc.)[/p][p]You no longer start with a free bedroll—you’ll need to craft it[/p][p]Bedroll crafting now requires rope or cured gut in addition to cloth[/p][p][/p][p]🧾 UI & UX Improvements[/p][p]Your current weight and max capacity now always display at the top of your backpack (next to filters)[/p][p]The backpack filter now turns red when you’re over-encumbered, as a subtle way of saying “you’ve hoarded too much again”[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback! If you haven’t already, join our [url="https://discord.gg/dPT8d6KVSC"]Discord [/url]to help shape the future of the game.[/p][p]👉 Try the latest demo and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3435110/Dont_Freeze_A_Winter_Card_Survival/"]wishlist the game [/url]if you're enjoying it![/p][p]Stay warm![/p]

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where moving cards between left and right columns (or vice versa) would display incorrect badge numbers when filtered
Fixed an issue with locale number formatting that caused players to die after the first turn (yes, that was real - thanks Unisus, and no, you did not miss anything, it was our bad)

tags.feature: Scrap metal can now be found in the Woods (low chance)

tags.balance_change: Harvesting a seat now gives 3 scrap metal (up from 2) and 4 seat cushions (up from 2)
Harvesting a seat cushion now gives 6 cloth (up from 4)
Rebalanced weight and harvesting values for tinder-related items (sticks, newspapers, etc.)
You no longer start with a free bedroll—you’ll need to craft it
Bedroll crafting now requires rope or cured gut in addition to cloth

tags.feature: Your current weight and max capacity now always display at the top of your backpack (next to filters)
The backpack filter now turns red when you’re over-encumbered, as a subtle way of saying “you’ve hoarded too much again”
